title.narrative: Readiness Assessment of Green Hydrogen in Shortlisted African Countries

description.narrative: The objective of the programme is to conduct a readiness evaluation of green hydrogen across short listed African Countries and to identify the opportunities and challenges in expanding affordable green hydrogen in combination with deploying offshore wind and solar energy sources. The aim is to look into country-specific parameters, financing requirements and possible methods of financing plus to categorize country risk assessment and mitigation plan in order for Africa to develop a green hydrogen economy.
